features.text: Specialized design maintains therapeutic 90° dorsiflexion position for optimal overnight stretching of the plantar fascia
Plush padded cover prevents skin irritation and ensures comfortable extended wear during sleep
Customizable support with included removable foam wedge for personalized treatment angles
Versatile design effectively treats both plantar fasciitis and various ankle conditions
Soft construction minimizes nighttime disruption while maintaining therapeutic positioning
